annotations.title: Get the Maple demo booking link

description: Use when a restaurant owner or operator wants to talk to Maple, see a demo, get set up or get a quote. Returns the maple.inc booking page and what the person will be asked for. Read-only: it does not book, submit a form or contact Maple, so give the link to the person and let them book the time themselves. Existing Maple customers who need help should use the Help Center link in the result instead.
name: get_demo_booking_link
title: Get the Maple demo booking link
